**Title:** BEACON

**Special UI Elements:**
*   **Rename Text Field:** A text input box labeled "PAY:" (for customizing the beacon's display name).
*   **Cost Text:** Level indicators (e.g., "L4") displayed beneath the power icons.
*   **Stacked Slots:** The "ST" (Status) icon is visually layered on top of the main inventory grid.
*   **Power-Selection Buttons:** Icons for Primary Powers (Speed, Haste, Resistance, Jump Boost) and Secondary Powers (Regeneration, Strength).
*   **Check/X Buttons:** Confirmation (Checkmark) and Cancel (X) buttons located to the right of the payment slot.
